text: {"lessons":["Selling stocks after large gains can reduce exposure to future growth; set deliberate limits for each position rather than selling repeatedly just because it has risen.","My account fell in the last four periods, including a 3.9% drop most recently, so gains are not guaranteed; keep risk and diversification appropriate for retirement needs.","Doing nothing can be sensible when there is no clear reason to trade, but I should still review the portfolio and make measured changes if its risk or balance no longer suits me."]}
